response.sql: WITH region_counts AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM client c JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), shares AS (SELECT region, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM region_counts) AS share FROM region_counts), avg_tbl AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares), above AS (SELECT s.cnt, s.share FROM shares s WHERE s.share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_tbl)) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_clients, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_tbl)) AS avg_excess_over_average FROM above;
